name: welco
description: Welco — guided project discovery & requirement management platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @welco/api" "npm run dev -w @welco/web"
scripts.build: node apps/api/scripts/db-provider.mjs mysql && node apps/api/scripts/bundle-serverless.mjs && npm run build -w @welco/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @welco/shared && npm run typecheck -w @welco/api && npm run typecheck -w @welco/web
